title: Static Long-Shaft Litter Picker
description: Original S01 static long-shaft litter picker with a true open handgrip, short trigger cue, shaft, fixed curved opposing jaws and flat gripping pads. Nine independently editable named mesh components. Actual contact with one unchanged legacy parcel and a lateral-offset collision negative are checked. No trigger linkage, jaw animation, holding-force, dynamic pickup or arbitrary-object grasp claim. See generate.py opening documentation for flat display orientation and fixed pad coordinates.
